title: One line in one book
note: The single surviving line that records a woman who made astrolabes.

beats.text: One line in one book is all we have

beats.sub: he lists every book and maker he knows

beats.callsub: an astrolabe measures where stars are

beats.text: One of them is a woman

beats.callsub: her father made astrolabes as well

beats.call: She worked in Aleppo, in Syria
beats.callsub: for the ruler there, Sayf al-Dawla

beats.text: We do not know her first name
beats.sub: the book that lists her does not say

beats.text: And none of her work survives
beats.sub: one line is the whole record of her

beats.text: Later books invent a name for her
